headline: What to expect from Google’s 2026 Pixel hardware launch event
summary: Google's annual Made by Google event is set for Wednesday. Expect new slab-style and foldable Pixel smartphones. Anticipate updated watches, new earbud colors, and potential new hardware.

headline: YouTube is making it harder to earn money on YouTube
summary: YouTube Partner Program requirements increase from February 1st, 2027. Creators will need 1,000 subscribers and 8,000 watch hours or 20 million Shorts views. This is a significant jump from current monetization thresholds.

headline: Four takeaways from Mark Zuckerberg’s massive AI manifesto
summary: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg published a 6,500-word AI manifesto. Titled 'The Future is for Everyone,' it outlines his vision for humanity and AI. Zuckerberg discusses the co-existence of humans with artificial intelligence.

headline: Apple will stream Friday Night Baseball live in Vision Pro
summary: Apple Vision Pro will stream Friday Night Baseball in immersive video from August 28th. The stream will feature live commentary and graphics anchored in the viewer's space. Replays will be available in the Apple TV app after games conclude.

headline: Save 30% off One of the Coolest and Most Interactive Space-Themed LEGO Sets Ever
summary: The LEGO Technic Planet Earth and Moon in Orbit 42179 set is on sale. Get 30% off this interactive space-themed LEGO set. It's currently available for just $51.99.

headline: Amazon Discounts MTG Commander Decks From Marvel and Strixhaven
summary: Amazon is offering deals on Magic: The Gathering Commander decks. Discounts include sets from Marvel and Strixhaven. Find the best Magic precon deals now.

headline: Score up to 20% off Select 256GB microSD Express Cards at Amazon
summary: Amazon has discounted select 256GB microSD Express cards. PNY and SanDisk cards are available with up to 20% off. Prices drop to $49.99 for PNY and $58.99 for SanDisk.

headline: Sonic the Hedgehog is Joining Fortnite, and Yes You'll Be Able to Dash Up Walls in the Green Hill Zone
summary: Sonic the Hedgehog is coming to Fortnite. He'll join as part of the battle royale's upcoming gaming-themed season. Players can expect to dash up walls in the Green Hill Zone.

headline: More than two-thirds of England now in drought
summary: Over two-thirds of England has officially entered drought status. Regions like East Midlands, Lincolnshire, and Kent are affected. The announcement covers several areas across the country.

headline: 30 years later, a former rival will stand trial for Tupac's murder
summary: A former rival will face trial for Tupac Shakur's murder, 30 years later. Tupac's reputation has grown significantly since his killing. The trial brings renewed attention to the iconic rapper's unsolved case.

headline: Record 230 people cross Channel in one small boat
summary: A record 230 people crossed the Channel in a single small boat. The Home Office condemns this as 'reckless and dangerous tactics' by gangs. Gangs are 'cramming ever greater numbers on to unseaworthy vessels.'

headline: New weight loss pill approved for use in UK
summary: Foundayo, a new weight loss pill, has been approved for use in the UK. It is manufactured by Eli Lilly, also known for the Mounjaro jab. The approval marks a new option in weight management treatments.
